subject: Recap: evidence path, retention exceptions, and next milestones
messages:
From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@aurelia.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@aurelia.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: audit logs, SOC 2 timeline and DPA redlines

Thanks for the call earlier — quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can move toward procurement. High level pain/goals we discussed: 

- Auditability: our security team needs >12 months of audit log retention for transaction traces and an immutable trail for incident investigations.
- SOC 2 timeline: we need to align Redwood's attestation cadence with our Q4 internal audit (target: Redwood SOC 2 Type II or equivalent evidence by Nov).
- DPA redlines: legal flagged a retention exception clause (45 days for user-level session logs) — we need to understand whether that can be supported or whether a technical compensating control is acceptable.
- Pen test: Aurelia requires a vendor pen-test window and a list of artifacts (signed scope + contact).

Concrete asks: can you send a concise artifact checklist and point people for the pen-test coordination? Also — can you confirm whether Redwood can support a 12 month retention for audit logs in hosted mode, or if we should plan on Dedicated/Private for that requirement?

Appreciate the summary and next steps.

—Sasha
Security Operations, Aurelia Financial

Attachment: DPA-redlines-aurelia.pdf (1 page, redline summary)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@aurelia.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@aurelia.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: audit logs, SOC 2 timeline and DPA redlines

Hi Sasha / Marco — thanks for the clear notes and for carving out time. Below is a concise recap from Redwood and the proposed next steps / owners. I’ve attached an artifact checklist and our suggested pen-test scoping doc.

Summary of what we heard (pain / goal):
- Need >=12 months of immutable audit logs for transaction trace and incident investigation.
- Align Redwood evidence with Aurelia’s Q4 internal audit (SOC 2 Type II evidence window).
- DPA: Aurelia requests a 45-day session-log retention exception; legal wants to see technical compensating controls if we cannot comply directly.
- Pen test: need scope, point of contact, and schedule window.

Redwood response / options:
- Hosted API: we can retain structured audit logs for 12 months but immutable retention and guaranteed isolation are only SLA-backed on Dedicated or Private deployments. For hosted, retention policies can be configured but would be tenant-scoped rather than fully isolated.
- Compensating control: if a hard 45-day exception is required for session-level logs, we can offer encrypted rolling snapshots of session metadata plus a signed attestation of access controls — recommended to limit to non-PII fields.
- Pen-test: we’ll run pen-test coordination from our Security Ops. Proposed POC: irene. Pen-test scope doc attached; timeline suggestion: Aug 2–6 (pending your availability).

Next steps (owners & dates):
1) Redwood to deliver artifact checklist + pen-test scope doc — owner: mateo — by EOD today. (see attachment: evidence-checklist.xlsx / pen-test-scope.docx)
2) Aurelia to confirm whether the 45-day session-log exception is a firm legal requirement or negotiable with compensating controls — owner: Sasha — by Fri 6/19.
3) Technical deep-dive (30 min) to show retention config and audit log schema — owner: neha — target week of 6/22.
4) If Dedicated/Private is preferred for isolation, schedule a cost/ops uplift review — owner: mateo — target by 6/26.

Irene & Neha — adding you for any technical/controls notes. Sasha / Marco — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the artifact checklist.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-checklist.xlsx, pen-test-scope.docx

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: audit logs, SOC 2 timeline and DPA redlines

Adding a few technical clarifications that will help Aurelia evaluate options during the 6/22 deep-dive:

- Audit log retention: we persist structured audit events (api.request, api.response, auth.event, admin.change) and can export to a customer-owned S3 bucket or stream to their SIEM for archival beyond 12 months. Hosted customers can use the export; Dedicated/Private provides immutable retention flags + tamper-evident storage.
- Scoped retention exception: session-level raw payloads often contain ephemeral user context. We can configure masking and reduce retention to 45 days for raw session payloads while retaining a 12-month indexed audit trail (transaction id, user id hash, action, timestamp) — that pattern is commonly accepted by customer infosec teams as a compensating control.
- Pen test coordination: our security team requires a signed NDA and an approved scope. I can be the technical contact for network/infra questions. Proposed sequence: NDA -> scope approval -> test window -> results delivery and remediation plan.

I’ll prepare a short deck for the 6/22 deep-dive showing sample log schema, masking examples, and the export flow to customer S3.

—Neha
Principal Security Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@aurelia.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@aurelia.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: audit logs, SOC 2 timeline and DPA redlines

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. A couple quick confirmations from our side: 

- We can accept a compensating-control approach if you can demonstrate the masking + 12-month indexed trail during the 6/22 session. Please include the export-to-S3 flow in the demo.
- NDA and pen-test scope: we’ll sign the NDA and return it by 6/18, then confirm the test window.
- DPA: legal will review the redlines attached and we’ll flag any non-negotiable points by 6/19.

I’ll get the internal security folks looped (cc’d Marco) and we’ll be ready for the 6/22 technical deep-dive. Once we’re aligned on retention and pen-test logistics, we’ll request a short procurement checklist and the DocuSign link for the order form.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — speak soon.

—Sasha
Security Operations, Aurelia Financial

Attachment: DPA-redlines-aurelia.pdf (acknowledged)
